newsitem.title: UK: Marley buys 17.5 mln stg ventilation firm.
newsitem.headline: Marley buys 17.5 mln stg ventilation firm.

text.p: Marley Plc UK, the residential and commercial refurbishment supplier, said on Friday it was buying ventilation products manufacturer Greenwood Air Mangement from the Hunter Group Plc for 17.5 million stg cash.

The UK manufacturer of extractor fans operates from sites in south east England and had sales in the year to June of 11.9 million stg, operating profits of 2.4 million stg and trading assets of 4.6 million stg.
Marley's chief executive David Trapnell said the acquisition would make the company a leading supplier in the UK and enable the group to expand in the sector.

"Greenwood has a strong market position in the UK ventilation market and other significant synergies with our existing ventilation activies in Europe and around the world," he said in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4017
